description: This Java source file defines the ConstantFieldConverter class, which implements conversion and reference creation logic for Android DOM elements within the IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment. It handles resolving constant fields based on annotations and context, providing code completion variants, and managing references to static constants in Android-related classes.

classes.name: ConstantFieldConverter
classes.description: A converter class for handling string representations and references to static constant fields in Android DOM elements, supporting code completion and resolution.

classes.name: MyReference
classes.description: An inner class extending PsiReferenceBase, providing logic to resolve references to static fields and generate code completion variants based on annotations and context.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a string from its source representation to the internal form (identity in this case).

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts the internal string value back to its source representation (identity in this case).

methods.name: createReferences
methods.description: Creates PSI references for a DOM value based on annotations, enabling navigation and code completion for constants.

methods.name: getFilteringSet
methods.description: Retrieves a set of valid constant strings based on the current context, such as category or action constants.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the reference to the corresponding PsiElement, typically a static field.

methods.name: resolveInner
methods.description: Performs the actual resolution logic by matching the value to static fields in the class.

methods.name: getVariants
methods.description: Provides code completion variants for the reference, filtering and listing static fields matching the prefix.

methods.name: processFields
methods.description: Processes static public string fields in the class that start with the specified lookup prefix.
